ground_truth.notes: 20-week first 50k trail plan for a road runner at 40 mpw. The key ultra-specific elements that MUST appear: (1) back-to-back long runs on Saturday + Sunday (this is the central ultra training stimulus), (2) trail-specific guidance — elevation, hiking uphills, time on feet over strict pace. Peak long run should reach 22-26mi. Peak week 55-65mi is appropriate. Week 1 close to current 40 mpw. 5 sessions/week.
